versions.changelog:
Initial OpenAPI skill package for Feishu integration.

- Added full Feishu OpenAPI Python API wrapper for Docx, Sheets, Base, Wiki, Drive, and IM, under `scripts/feishu_api`.
- Included standalone tools for doc operations: environment check, doc resolve, read, create, append, and block list.
- Provided service-layer wrappers for advanced API operations, supporting user and app token flows.
- Added reference documentation and setup guides for credentials, token handling, and OpenClaw bot routing.
- Safe handling of app credentials and user tokens—no hard-coding; all secrets required in `.env`.
- Removed legacy or previous bridge/skill configuration files.
